brief:
A Palestinian American watched via security camera from thousands of miles away as militant Israeli settlers encircled his West Bank house, fearing permanent loss of his home amid increasing Israeli seizures of Palestinian property, according to Al-Monitor. The incident occurred in Qusra, in the occupied West Bank, where settler actions have intensified against Palestinian landholders.

The report details growing tensions over property control in the territory, with settlers employing siege tactics against Palestinian residents. The homeowner monitored the threat remotely while unable to reach his property, as organized settler groups pressed claims against Palestinian land holdings.

title: Palestinian American returns to West Bank home under settler siege
